interpretation: The large bare-policy simulator uplift does not survive a symmetric wasteful-end-turn recovery proxy.
The proxy improves both frozen policies dramatically, demonstrating that raw EndTurn outcomes dominated the prior comparison.
The remaining guarded result is effectively neutral and slightly worse on aggregate reward and player HP, consistent with the failed 10-pair live floor gate.

Independent source and trace audit found no action-index or packaging mismatch; the remaining high-confidence training defect is failure to preserve parent card-to-card ranking when both actions are non-EndTurn.
The proxy is not an exact CombatRLAgent fallback implementation and grants no mechanics-equivalence or promotion authority.

decision.next_training_direction: Add and test a frozen-parent card-to-card ranking constraint before producing another candidate. Require guard-aware simulator evidence before future packaging or live evaluation.
